column1: # ZAP baseline rules for StaySphere (rule id<TAB>IGNORE|WARN|FAIL<TAB>reason). Anything not listed is a WARN (reported, not failing).
# Headers and cookies we promise in docs/architecture/05-security.md are FAIL: a regression breaks the build.

column3: (Anti-clickjacking header missing - we send X-Frame-Options DENY and frame-ancestors none)
(Cookie without HttpOnly - the refresh cookie must be HttpOnly)
(Application error disclosure - stack traces must never reach clients)
(Cookie without Secure - the CI stack is plain http on localhost; production is HTTPS-only behind Front Door)
(Strict-Transport-Security - set at the edge (Front Door); the CI stack is http)
(Absence of anti-CSRF tokens - the API authenticates with bearer tokens, not cookies; the refresh cookie is SameSite=Strict on one path)
(Timestamp disclosure - ISO dates in JSON are data)
(Storable and cacheable content - hashed static assets are cached on purpose)
